en: Verses in Praise of the Five Tathāgatas. Om. Homage to the Glorious One who has reached the end of the five elements! Homage to you, O Supreme King who grants boons; homage be to you, the limit of reality (bhūtakoṭi)!
Salutations to you, whose essence is emptiness; O awakening of the Buddha, homage be to you! || 1 ||
O passion for the Buddha, homage be to you; O desire for the Buddha, homage be to you.
O joy in the Buddha, homage be to you; O delight in the Buddha, salutations, salutations! (2)
O Buddha-smile, homage to you; O Buddha-laughter, salutations again and again. O Buddha-speech, may there be homage to you; O Buddha-nature, salutations again and again. || 3 ||
Homage be to you, O source of non-existence; homage be to you, O source of the Buddha.
Homage be to you, O source of space; homage be to you, O source of primordial wisdom.

Homage to you, O Net of Illusion! Homage to you, the Leader of the Buddhas! Homage to you who are all things for all; homage be to you, the Body of Gnosis! The verse of praise to the five glorious Tathāgatas is complete.
